instruction: Answer with the text visible in the image, using a word or short phrase. Do not explain.
input_allowlist: native chat template + original image and question + exact frozen short-answer instruction; no auxiliary OCR/hint/caption/Gold
engine: unmodified V2; no C1/C2 projection repair
zero_only_scratch: retained; real cost included if speed gate passes; not persistent original visual KV
selection_A: rank highest official soft accuracy first; ties lower meta rate, lower actual mean quality-EOS KV capacity, fewer layers, frozen order; select top3 reaccess plus R0

selection_B.best_efficiency: within 2.0 percentage points of highest soft accuracy; choose fewest retained layers, then lower actual KV capacity, lower meta rate, higher accuracy, frozen order; R0 eligible

bootstrap.multiplicity: ordinary unadjusted exploratory CI; not confirmatory noninferiority

hard_stop: input/source hash mismatch, Native/Noop failure, NaN/Inf, OOM, illegal token length, KV/Mask/RoPE/exit/skip/cache/hook structural error
output_policy: all meta/repeat/empty/truncated/wrong answers retained and scored; known frequent Physical meta outputs do not stop this task
smoke: 8 frozen Discovery; Native/Noop strict; Dense/Physical R0,R4-M,R8; full structural audit shortest and longest, light logits for remaining six; BF16 errors recorded not gated
Native_reuse: sample freeze first, exact input/model/processor/tokenizer/cap/source binding; Holdout prediction text/tokens/scores not loaded before final selection
speed_gate: at least one preselected non-R0 candidate has Holdout soft gain>0 AND paired image-cluster ordinary95%CI lower>0; speed precedence fixed as best_quality then best_efficiency among confirmed candidates; no Holdout reranking, new layers or quality generation

speed.boundary: GPU-ready input through Vision/projector/prefill/decode/method cleanup, synchronized wall time; exclude disk/tokenizer/preprocessor/H2D/write
